findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "gmail-agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_single_email · Public sink: compose_email, read_single_email · Destructive: compose_email, read_single_email, latest_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_single_email · Public sink: compose_email, read_single_email · Destructive: compose_email, read_single_email, latest_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
